name: [EVENT] River Hunter
desc:
Loy Krathong Festival! November 23 - December 2
- Float a krathong at the head of the pier. Add money to the krathong for good luck and to catch rare fish.
- Floating lantern bait can attract 6 types of goldfish during the event: Aranda, Ryukin, Blackmore, Crystal-scaled, Bulging-eyed, and Ranchu (some varieties appear only at night).
- Collect event points to redeem rewards, with the grand prize being an event fishing rod skin.
- Goldfish scooping station: Requires concentration to move paper without tearing it
- A giant goldfish boss appears in the water. Fight together to earn a rank on your head and have a chance to get a rare golden color.
- Release sky lanterns, watch fireworks, accompanied by nighttime temple music
- Tap on your favorite fish to prevent accidental sales.

River Hunter: A Thai-style fishing game where you hunt local bosses, build your own home, and raise fish in your personal tanks.

What's in the game
- Various fishing rods: For striking artificial bait, targeting shallow water fish, bottom feeders, and jigging. Features a wide selection of reels, lines, and baits.
- Many types of Thai fish have rare colors, giant sizes, and dedicated fish collection books.
- Large local bosses in each zone. Engage in long battles and compete for the fastest records throughout the game.
- Build a house, decorate it, dig a dirt pond, set up an aquarium, and rebirth to upgrade your house and unlock new areas.
- Drive cars, ride boats, ride elephants, and go fishing across the map.
- At night, be careful of people sneaking in to steal fish from the pond!

If you find any bugs or have ideas, please let us know on the game's Discord server (RiverHunter).
